sources.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
sources.evidence: October 7, 2026 launch of Claude Haiku 5.5; names exact API ID claude-haiku-5-5 and hosted availability; describes fast classification, summaries, support, and subagent work.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 overview
sources.evidence: Exact-model page confirms October 7, 2026 release, 1M-token context, adaptive thinking, text/image input and text output; comparison table has no model parameter counts.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Haiku 5.5
sources.evidence: 144-page October 7, 2026 card obtained via curl from the official system-card redirect. Page 8 names Anthropic and Haiku-class model, describes training and text-only output. Full-text inspection found no parameter-count or architecture disclosure; parameter mentions concern effort settings.

sources.title: Model system cards
sources.evidence: Current index lists Haiku 5.5 (October 2026) as latest card, followed by September 2026 Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5; no later first-party card listed to check for an exact-name count disclosure.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub: Claude Haiku 5.5 summary
sources.evidence: Exact-model summary supplies text/image input, text output and pretraining/post-training descriptions, but no production architecture or parameter counts.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing, represented internally as page images with extracted text; Haiku 5.5 is explicitly active in its model overview.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 migration guide
sources.evidence: Exact-model guide states fixed claude-haiku-5-5 identifier with no separate alias; documents forced tool choice, tool calls, computer use and browser tools.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API access is licensed service use, subject to restrictions; Anthropic retains intellectual-property rights except those expressly granted. Supports proprietary classification together with exact-model hosted availability.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: September 29, 2026 research states Claude weights are not publicly released or customizable. General Claude distribution evidence, used with the later Haiku 5.5 hosted-only launch rather than as exact-model architectural evidence.

sources.title: Models.dev Claude Haiku 5.5 record
sources.evidence: Baseline catalog link inspected as a lead; technical claims independently checked against Anthropic sources.

name.note: Exact official release name and fixed API model identifier match the record.

developer.note: System-card introduction identifies Anthropic as the developer.

family.note: Catalog-normalized family; executive summary explicitly calls this a Haiku-class model.

release_date.note: Launch announcement, model overview and system-card cover explicitly agree on October 7, 2026.

open_weights.note: Exact launch offers hosted Claude and cloud/API access; consistent with Anthropic public statement that Claude weights are not released to users. No weight distribution is offered.

license.note: Descriptive service/model licensing classification, not an SPDX weight license. API use is governed by Anthropic commercial terms and no public model weights are distributed.

parameters_b.note: No total learned-parameter count disclosed in inspected exact-model card, transparency summary or model comparison table. Current official card index has no later card. Exact-name parameter and billion-count searches found no primary disclosure.

active_parameters_b.note: No activated-parameter count or dense/MoE structure disclosed in inspected primary material. Do not infer active parameters from pricing, size adjectives or inference effort settings.

architecture.note: Card and transparency hub describe training but not network structure. Exact-name searches on Anthropic research and transformer-circuits.pub did not locate architectural disclosure. No sibling-model structure is transferred.

context_window.note: Exact-model capability table reports 1M tokens, normalized to 1,000,000.

modalities.note: Overview confirms text/image input and text output; all active models support PDF processing. PDF is an accepted document format handled through text and images.

reasoning.note: Adaptive thinking explicitly supported and enabled by default.

tool_call.note: Exact-model migration guide explicitly documents forced tool_choice, emitted tool calls and computer/browser tools.

description.value: Fast Claude model for responsive assistance, classification, and lightweight agents
description.note: Concise summary supported by official speed-sensitive support, classification and narrowly scoped subagent use cases; lightweight refers to task scope, not an asserted parameter count.

sources.label: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities

summary: Confirmed name, developer, family, October 7 release, closed weights, 1M context, text/image/PDF input, text output, reasoning, tool use and description. Fill null license with proprietary and replace catalog-only provenance with primary evidence. Total and active parameter counts and architecture remain undisclosed after exact-model system-card inspection, comparison-table review and targeted research searches.
